<!-- Generated by npm run docs:gen. Do not edit. Edit examples in site/src/content/examples/. -->

Load entries from a bundle file. Use it to restore a journal or to move it to a new machine.

:::caution
An import can add to or change the entries that you have. Make a backup first. Read the [backups guide](/gournal/docs/guides/data-safety-and-backups/).
:::

## CLI

### gournal import

Load entries from a bundle file. Make the bundle with gournal export --format bundle.

```text
gournal import <file>
```

#### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `<file>` | yes | Path of the bundle file. |
